classification: source-inspected assertions and testable concerns, not demonstrated vulnerabilities

boundaries.finding: Empty JWT secret bypasses user auth; namespace context still selected. Configured JWT activates role checks; static users override namespace-role claims.
boundaries.safe_test: Fixture empty/configured secret and viewer/operator/admin cross-namespace requests; assert exact rejection and no mutation.

boundaries.finding: Empty bootstrap token permits registration; configured token is registration authority. Random node credentials are separately required on report/task/heartbeat paths.
boundaries.safe_test: Local handler registers synthetic node; wrong bootstrap rejected only when configured.

boundaries.finding: Random bearer value hash plus expiry/revocation; server maps own current credential record. Transport confidentiality is separate.
boundaries.safe_test: Wrong/expired/revoked token and wrong-node status fixtures; never capture token values.

boundaries.finding: Active agent targets literal127.0.0.1 at assigned published TCP port; generic checker accepts arbitrary targets and uses default HTTP transport with same-origin redirects.
boundaries.safe_test: Local fixtures prove assigned-port gate and cross-origin redirect rejection; inspect proxy/default-DNS semantics separately.

boundaries.finding: Optional HMAC signs payload but does not authenticate receiver authorization. HTTP client permits default redirect/network behavior; validation is not an outbound allowlist.
boundaries.safe_test: Injected RoundTripper records synthetic redirect and error; loopback-only endpoint. Do not send to metadata/public targets.

boundaries.finding: Lexical relative path checks do not resolve symlinks. Stat/ReadFile may follow a selected YAML link or configured path.
boundaries.safe_test: Temp local fixture symlink to temp benign outside-file proves or falsifies read boundary; no host-secret target.

boundaries.finding: Argument vector plus -- prevents shell interpolation; repository protocols/credential-bearing stderr and symlinks remain different boundaries.
boundaries.safe_test: Fake fetcher and local Git fixture; URL-userinfo/query rejection; no shell execution claim transferred to filesystem sandbox.

boundaries.finding: Docker socket authority is host-level runtime privilege; admission limits workload fields, not daemon administrator privilege.
boundaries.safe_test: Fake runtime asserts restricted security spec; real daemon tests only on owned disposable scope.

boundaries.finding: AES-GCM protects stored envelope; local configured key must remain available. Agents/Docker receive plaintext environment values.
boundaries.safe_test: Synthetic secret create/read/assignment and redaction fixtures; never export actual environment.

boundaries.finding: Pprof handler itself has no authentication; separate listener disabled by default and configurable. Metrics bypass user JWT.
boundaries.safe_test: Local-only handler path assertions plus config listener validation; do not expose debug to network.

boundaries.finding: Optional UDP resolver exposes service/task topology according to context and address binding; namespace API checks do not encrypt DNS.
boundaries.safe_test: Local packet fixture, query namespace/name, inspect exact records; no external resolver dependency.

boundaries.finding: DB credentials grant durable data operations for package callers; migration authority can change schema. Main DB schema check optional.
boundaries.safe_test: Separate lab database credentials and full migration ledger; never use owner database.

remaining_runtime_tests: Run through isolated lab/review gates; no security certification inferred.
